name: Taxually For WooCommerce
author: taxually

sections.description:
Connect your WooCommerce store and let Taxually handle everything: VAT and sales tax registration, monthly filings, and direct representation with tax authorities across the EU, UK, US, Australia, and beyond. No manual exports. No missed deadlines. No compliance anxiety.

Handle the full compliance journey, not just calculation

Most tax tools stop at checkout. Taxually goes further. Our platform and team of tax experts take care of what happens after the transaction: registration, filing, remittance, and representation with tax authorities. If you’re already using a calculation tool like Avalara or Stripe Tax, Taxually handles the rest.

Your data syncs automatically

Connect once and your WooCommerce transaction data flows to Taxually every month. No CSV exports, no manual uploads, no back-and-forth with your accountant.

Real tax experts behind the platform

Taxually isn’t just software. Our team of tax professionals manages your filings directly and represents you with tax authorities when needed. Audit defence is built in.

Built for merchants who are serious about growth

Whether you’ve just triggered your first VAT obligation or you’re managing compliance across dozens of jurisdictions, Taxually scales with you.

  • VAT compliance across all 27 EU member states, UK, Norway, and Switzerland
  • US sales tax filing and nexus monitoring across all applicable states
  • Australia GST and other international jurisdictions
  • Fiscal representation where legally required
  • Self-service onboarding in under an hour

Trusted by 20,000+ companies. 150+ countries covered. 60-80% savings on compliance costs vs. manual processes.

“We reduced VAT compliance staff from ten to three.” – Razor Group
“Saving 20-30 hours per month in VAT preparation.” – Gelato
“Volumes of queries from tax authorities are dropping.” – Amer Sports

Get started

Install the plugin, connect your Taxually account, and you’re done. Visit taxually.com to set up your account or book a demo.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually
  3. Click “Connect to Taxually” and sign in with your Taxually account
  4. Specify your fulfilment location(s)
  5. Your transaction data syncs automatically. Taxually handles compliance from there.

Important note

This plugin handles automated data sync between WooCommerce and Taxually. Real-time checkout tax calculation is on the product roadmap. The current value is on the filing and compliance side: what happens after the transaction.

External services

This plugin connects to the Taxually API to enable OAuth-based authentication and to allow Taxually to pull your WooCommerce transaction data for tax compliance purposes.

Taxually API

The plugin communicates with the following Taxually API endpoint:

  • Production: https://taxually-api.azurewebsites.net

What data is sent and when:

During the connection flow, the plugin sends the following data to the Taxually API:

  • Your store URL and store display name
  • A PKCE code challenge (a one-time cryptographic value used to secure the OAuth flow)
  • WooCommerce REST API credentials (consumer key and secret), which are transmitted once at the end of the OAuth flow so Taxually can pull order data from your store

No data is sent until you explicitly initiate the connection by clicking “Connect to Taxually” in the plugin settings. Once connected, Taxually accesses your store data (orders, products, customer addresses) directly via the WooCommerce REST API on a scheduled basis for tax compliance processing.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/taxually, or install directly via the WordPress plugin screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually
  4. Connect your Taxually account using your API credentials
  5. Specify your fulfilment location(s)
  6. Your data will begin syncing automatically on the next monthly cycle
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Where are the plugin settings?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Taxually.

Do I need a Taxually account?

Yes. You will need a Taxually account to use this plugin. You can sign up and start self-service onboarding at taxually.com or book a demo. Most merchants are set up in under an hour.

Which countries does Taxually cover?

EU VAT: all 27 EU member states plus UK, Norway, and Switzerland. US sales tax: all states with sales tax obligations. Additional coverage includes Australia GST and other jurisdictions globally.

Does this plugin calculate tax at checkout?

Not currently. The plugin handles automated data sync from WooCommerce to Taxually. Checkout tax calculation is on the roadmap. If you need real-time calculation, Taxually can work alongside tools such as Avalara or Stripe Tax.

What data does this plugin share with Taxually?

Transaction amounts, shipping addresses, product details, tax amounts, and fulfilment location data. Only the data required for compliance filing is transferred.

Is my data secure?

Yes. The plugin uses OAuth-based authentication. Your API key is generated on connection and automatically revoked when you disconnect.

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes. You can disconnect from the plugin settings page at any time. This will immediately revoke Taxually’s API access to your store.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
